svg.text: Locations & demographics: USA Fencing Club Directory + public-domain club archive + club websites (745 of 908 clubs, holding 98.5% of U.S.-based competitive fencers); U.S. Census 2025 Pop. Estimates & 2024 Median Household Income.

svg.text: National events: USA Fencing calendars, 2021-22 through 2026-27 seasons (44 hosted & scheduled North American Cup / Junior Olympics / Summer Nationals stops in 21 cities). Independent project; not affiliated with USA Fencing or U.S. Census.

svg.text: Notes: Competitive = paid tier required for sanctioned tournaments. Club-affiliated members only (excludes Unattached; dual-club members may appear under both clubs). Memberships renew each Aug 1.
